title: SR-71A internal structure and systems stations for the exploded model

frame.x: x_m = (FS_in - 102) * 0.0254. FS 102 is the radome tip (TM-4749 figs 4 and 5); FS 1355 is the tail cone tip, x = 31.826 m.
frame.y: y_m = BL_in * 0.0254, positive to the right wing. NASA YF-12 papers give spanwise positions as WS (wing station) measured from the aircraft centreline, so WS is treated as BL: the YF-12 nacelle centreline WS 170 (TM X-2880 table 3, N points) equals the 14.17 ft nacelle offset of TN D-6987 fig 2.
frame.z: z_m = (WL_in - 82.0) * 0.0254 (proposed). Anchor: TM-4749 labels the upper fuselage line WL 131 (figs 4 and 5); in the existing model that line sits at z = 1.245 m for x = 9 to 17 m, so WL0 = 131 - 1.245/0.0254 = 82.0.
z_checks: TM-4749 fig 5 side view (scaled with its own FS 102 and FS 1355 leaders, 1.483 px/in, leaders agree to 5 in): radome tip WL 79.7, chine line at FS 500 WL 87.8, belly WL 64.9. The conversion gives model values WL 82.0 (radome tip, z = 0), WL 85.8 (chine, z = 0.098 m) and WL 65.1 (belly, z = -0.43 m). Agreement within 2.3 in.
SR-71A-1 fig 4-24 side view (scaled 0.1445 in/px, see calibration notes): radome tip about WL 77.5 and belly WL 63.7 if its top line is WL 131.
TM-4749 nomenclature: moment reference point FS 900, BL 0, WL 100 (z = 0.457 m), near the body mid-depth of the model (about z = 0.41 m). The symbol drawn in fig 5 sits at about WL 94.

YF-12 cross-check (TM X-2880 table 3, V points): the fuselage underside at the ventral fin root runs from WL 69.5 at FS 1127.6 to WL 80.6 at FS 1270.8, consistent with a common WL datum for the family.
frame.sides: Where an item has side "both", BL and y are given for the right side; mirror with negative y for the left. Items with side "left" or "right" carry the sign of that side only where a BL is given.
frame.z_uncertainty: plus or minus 3 in (0.08 m). Alternative: anchor the radome tip (WL about 80 by TM-4749 fig 5) instead, which lowers every z by about 0.05 m relative to the model outline.
frame.datum_across_types: Fuselage stations are common to the A-12, YF-12 and SR-71 in the wing, nacelle and tail region: main gear well FS 914 to 954 in the YF-12 text (TM X-2880 p.2 to 3) and the A-12 manual (cover 70, "W.S. 914 to W.S. 954"), and FS 920 to 948 measured on the SR-71A fig 4-37; cowl lip near FS 790 to 800 on the SR-71A (fig 4-37, model trace) and the YF-12 (TM X-2880 fig 5a); the YF-12 movable rudder root leading edge NS 1076.6 matches the SR-71 fin leading edge at FS 1077 in the model trace. The forebodies differ: radome tip FS 90 (YF-12, TM X-2880), FS 102 (SR-71A, TM-4749); the YF-12 canopies span about FS 265 to 404 (TM X-2880 fig 5a concluded, p.43, scaled between its FS 90 and FS 670 labels), about 25 in further aft than the SR-71A canopies (FS 243 to 374, FM fig 4-37). Do not carry forebody stations across types.

confidence_levels.labelled: Station printed on a labelled drawing or in a table
confidence_levels.measured: Measured from a drawing by scaling between labelled stations on the same figure
confidence_levels.estimated: Estimated from a drawing without station labels (method stated)
confidence_levels.derived: Derived by calculation from published dimensions (method stated)

calibrations.TMX2880_fig2a: TM X-2880 fig 2a (YF-12 generalized structure, plan): calibrated to its five labelled section cuts A-A FS 254, B-B 365, C-C 580, D-D 738, E-E 1040 plus the nose (FS 90) and fuselage end (FS 1310) from the text: FS = 0.67092 * px - 543.89 on the 300 dpi page (pages/ntrs-19730021212_TM-X-2880_p37_fig2a_*.png), residuals under 3 in. The printed inch axis of the figure is offset about 5.5 in from the drawn aircraft; the section labels were preferred. WS from the figure axis, WS = (row - 987) / 1.506.
calibrations.FM_fig4-24: SR-71A-1 fig 4-24 (plan and side of the forward fuselage, no stations): radome tip at row 4958 of the 4167 x 5834 page; one scale 0.1445 in/px fitted to the chine planform of the model trace (FS 105 to 344, rms 0.6 in). Checks: side-view body depth 67 in (model 65.7 in); canopy hump FS 245 to 381 (TM-4749 fig 5: FS 244 to 389). FS = 102 + (4958 - row) * 0.1445. Beyond FS 460 the figure could not be checked independently.
calibrations.FM_fig4-37: SR-71A-1 fig 4-37 (whole-aircraft plan, no stations): radome tip x = 567 px, tail cone tip x = 3697 px on the 4167 x 5834 page, 2.498 px/in, FS = 102 + (x - 567) / 2.498. Checks: main gear wells FS 920 to 948 (YF-12 and A-12: 914 to 954), outboard elevon hinge FS 1176 to 1182 (YF-12 EO 1 to 6: 1181 to 1187), cowl lip FS 790 (YF-12 fig 5a about 799).
calibrations.FM_fig1-21: SR-71A-1 fig 1-21 (nacelle section schematic, Mach 0 panel): scaled between the cowl lip (FS 790, fig 4-37) and the engine face (cowl lip plus 5.4 Rc = 159 in, CR-163106 figs 4 and 7, Rc = 29.38 in from TM X-3144 fig 8): 0.3087 in/px on the 2142 x 3000 media file. Checks: spike tip FS 692 (fig 4-37: 689); nacelle exit FS 1227 (fig 4-37: 1234).
calibrations.FM_fig1-40: SR-71A-1 fig 1-40 (axonometric schematic of the tanks): positions of tank end ellipses projected on the fuselage axis of the drawing, scaled between the main gear well (tank 3 aft end FS 914, tank 4 forward end FS 954; the drawing closes the gap) and the tail cone tip (FS 1355); 0.552 in per display unit. Checks: tank 2 to 3 boundary falls at FS 739, matching the YF-12 forward wing box start FS 738 (tank 3 group = forward wing boxes plus a fuselage tank, FM p.1-50); tank 1A forward end falls at FS 404, matching the air refuelling receptacle door FS 403 to 442 measured on fig 4-37 (fig 1-40 puts the receptacle on top of tank 1A). Uncertainty about 25 in.
calibrations.FM_fig2-3: SR-71A-1 fig 2-3 dimensions with p.1-4: turn centre on the main axle line, (28.3 + 47.4)/2 = 37.85 ft from the aircraft centreline; nose gear sqrt(54.5^2 - 37.85^2) = 39.21 ft ahead of the main axle (steering angle 46 deg against the 45 deg limit); probe tip sqrt(81.7^2 - 37.85^2) = 72.40 ft ahead of the main axle. With overall length 107.4 ft (p.1-4) ending at the tail cone FS 1355 (TM-4749), the probe tip is FS 66.2, the main axle FS 935.0 and the nose gear axle FS 464.5.
calibrations.TM4749_fig4: TM-4749 fig 4 plan view, 300 dpi page: least-squares fit to its FS 102, 736.5, 1226.5, 1295 and 1355 leaders, FS = 0.69304 * px - 112.84, residuals up to 9 in.
calibrations.TM4749_fig5: TM-4749 fig 5 side view, 300 dpi page: FS 102 leader at x = 364 px, FS 1355 at x = 2222 px (1.4828 px/in); other leaders (1023, 1033, 1041.9, 1196.5, 1230.9, 1244.6, 1295) fall within 5 in. WL from the labelled WL 131 line at row 725.5 with the same scale.
